Gulliver easily pulled all the warships of the enemy after him

options.text: All the warships of the enemy had been easily pulled by Gulliver after him.
All the warships of the enemy were easily pulled by Gulliver after him.
All the warships of the enemy were being easily pulled by Gulliver after him.

• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject 'Guliver' of the active voice becomes the object, the object ''all the warships of the enemy'' becomes the subject.
 
• The passive format "'were + V3 (pulled)" should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2*.*

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle ABC with AB = AC and AD is perpendicular to BC, if AD = 6 cm and the perimeter of ΔABC is 36 cm, then the area of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Δ ABC is an isosceles triangle , AB = AC 

Ad = 6 cm 

**Formula used **

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height 

**Figure:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf768c3c6110d7d2a6c18aa7f6820156caa0c05301f0fafa045457fd6e5efda.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let, Base = b, and two equal sides = a 

According to the given data,

⇒ 2a + b = 36 ---(1)

⇒ 2a = 36 - b

⇒ a = (36 - b)/2 ---(2)

Now, AD perpendicular to BC ,so ΔADB is a right angle triangle.

So, AB² = AD² + BD²

⇒ a² = 6² + (b/2)²

⇒ a2 = 36 + b²/4

⇒ a2 - b2/4 = 36 

⇒ 4a2 - b2 = 36 × 4

⇒ (2a + b) (2a - b) = 144

Putting the value of (2a + b) from equation (1),

⇒ 36 × (2a - b) = 144

⇒ 2a - b = 4

Putting the value of b from equation (2),

⇒ 2 × (36 - b)/2 - b = 4

⇒ (36 - b) - b = 4

⇒ 36 - 2b = 4

⇒ 2b = 36 - 4 

⇒ b = 32/2 = 16 cm

So, the area of the Δ ABC = 1/2 × 16 × 6 = 48 cm²

∴ Area of triangle ABC is 48 cm2
